# DA-01 Independent Review — Durable H2 Owner Decision

## Verdict: ALL PASS

All hard gates pass. `CR12-FEAT34-H2-owner-decision.md` is an accurate durable record of the
bounded user approval and does not turn that approval into MSP, implementation, runtime, release,
or H2-closure authority. It does not change the existing requirement for governed promotion,
explicit contract language, executed fail-closed evidence, and independent acceptance.

## Evidence reviewed

- DA-01 brief and the recorded approval interpretation in `.rwang-progress.md`: the six approved
  items are Option A; current `OWNER` + `DEV` inclusion through `ownership:R`; candidate-only
  named reviewer; immediate inactive/revoked/expired/suspended lifecycle denial; telemetry for
  reads plus durable atomic audit for mutations; and no Visual Office global-role mutation.
- The GR-02 decision/review chain and integrated gate packet: H2 was previously
  `BLOCKED / UNDECIDED`; the two Team/Employee and audit-precedent warnings remain separate debt;
  H1/H3-H5, preflight, implementation, runtime, and release remain gated.
- Current tree inventory: no `src/app` Visual Office path and no matching Prisma symbol were
  found. This confirms the record's absence statement only; it is not implementation evidence.

| 1 | Exact fidelity to six approved items | HARD | PASS | Items 1-6 preserve the approved Option A/OWNER+DEV, candidate-only reviewer, lifecycle denial, telemetry-plus-atomic-audit, no-role, and fail-closed decisions without adding a different access model. |
| 2 | Approval-evidence integrity | HARD | PASS | Document control identifies the user's `approve` reply immediately after the six-item prompt, and explicitly says no external signature, MSP approval, or promotion is claimed. |
| 3 | Lifecycle, read-audit, and no-role boundaries | HARD | PASS | The record denies inactive Employees and inactive/revoked/expired/suspended grants; selects access telemetry for reads and durable atomic audit for protected mutations with strict allowlists; and forbids role fields and Team/Employee/ownership-transfer paths. |
| 4 | Remaining H2 prerequisites and non-authorization | HARD | PASS | It keeps H2 open pending MSP promotion/index proof, explicit API v1 §9.1 wording, real wrapper/route/repository fail-closed tests, audit failure/allowlist proof, and independent security acceptance. It explicitly preserves H1, H3-H5, preflight, implementation, runtime, release, and MSP boundaries. |
| 5 | Document control and change history | SOFT | PASS | YAML metadata, scoped document-control table, version `1.0.0`, stable status, version diff, and CHANGELOG are present and internally consistent. |
| 6 | Clarity, traceability, and scope discipline | SOFT | PASS | Proposal/approval/implementation states are separated clearly. The record carries the earlier GR-02 warnings forward as separate Core RBAC/Team debt and neither edits nor authorizes code, schema, authority, generated targets, or runtime work. |

## Findings

No hard or soft findings. The prior GR-02 WARN-01 and WARN-02 are correctly preserved as
out-of-scope existing-path debt and as future H2 evidence requirements; DA-01 does not falsely
clear them.

## Review boundary

This verdict accepts the completeness and fidelity of the DA-01 decision record only. It does not
close H2, accept/promote an MSP artifact, amend API authority, approve H1/H3-H5, clear preflight,
authorize implementation, or establish runtime/release truth.
